hotel_name: Hotel O By Oyo Telone Stay

positive_snippets: Comfort and experience of a 4 star hotel at the price of a budget hotel. I believe the only budget hotel in Gurgaon in an otherwise geography crowded with guest houses.
negative_snippets:
PLEASE DON'T BOOK THIS PLACE

I recently booked this place for 4 days of stay for attending a conference at SGT University,
Since my flight was delayed and using the google location I was left at a place where no such structure existed.

THIS IS A PROPER SCAM which will teach you to not just rely on reviews.

Very bad. Hotel is not there in the location(gurugram). Today I came to the location but hotel is not there. Everything what you see in google is wrong. I paid money online after checking in google but no hotel. Very bad experience.please don’t book this hotel
